The '''Great Sea''' was a sea on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Belasco/Legends|Belasco]]. [[Senta]], [[Capital/Legends|capital city]] of Belasco and home to the palace were the royal family that ruled Belasco lived, sat on top of the golden hills that overlooked the sea.
